name: Orbital Rainbow
original_name: オービタルレインボウ
source:
This is a tale of universe, time, and bonds.
The orbital satellite triggered the end of the world.
Under the rainbow,
school crusaders will change the world beyond chrono rule.
The past and the present cross and make the only one future.

I won't forget our summer and dreams.
...and believe we will meet again in August ten years after.

[From the cover]
